overview.summary: An immersive 10-day solo journey through Kerala's cultural heart and lush highlands. Experience the colonial charm and vibrant art scene of Fort Kochi before escaping into the mist-covered tea gardens and serene nature trails of Munnar.
overview.best_time_note: February offers crisp, cool air in Munnar and pleasant, dry warm weather along the coast in Kochi, ideal for sightseeing and trekking.

weather.conditions: Pleasant and dry in Kochi; crisp, cool, and mist-laden in Munnar.

options.details: Non-stop flight from Mumbai (BOM) to Kochi (COK), approx. 2 hours each way.
pros: Saves nearly two full days compared to train

options.details: Mangala Lakshadweep Express or Netravati Express from LTT/Panvel to Ernakulam Junction.
cons: Takes a full day in each direction

transport.recommendation_reason: Given the 10-day trip length, flying maximizes exploring time while comfortably remaining within your INR 45,000 budget.
transport.local_transport: KSRTC state buses, Uber/Ola autos in Kochi, public ferries in Fort Kochi, and shared/hired autos in Munnar.

stay.area_recommendation: Stay in Fort Kochi for heritage walking accessibility, and Old Munnar or Chithirapuram for serene hostel vibe and mountain views.

options.name: Zostel Fort Kochi
options.why_good: Vibrant solo-traveler community, walking distance to cafes and heritage spots.

places_to_visit.name: Eravikulam National Park
places_to_visit.why_visit: Home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr and stunning high-altitude grasslands.

places_to_visit.name: KDHP Tea Museum
places_to_visit.why_visit: Learn about the century-old history of tea plantations in Munnar.

places_to_visit.name: Fort Kochi Chinese Fishing Nets & Promenade
places_to_visit.why_visit: Iconic historical fishing structures introduced by Chinese traders in the 14th century.

places_to_visit.name: Mattancherry Jew Town & Synagogue
places_to_visit.why_visit: Quaint narrow streets lined with antique shops, spice warehouses, and centuries of Jewish heritage.

packing_list: Light woolens / jacket / fleece for Munnar evenings
Comfortable trekking shoes and cotton socks
Light breathing cotton clothes for humid Kochi weather
Rain shell or compact umbrella (occasional mist)
Personal medicine kit and bug spray
safety_and_tips: Munnar ghat roads have sharp turns; take anti-motion sickness medication if prone to car sickness.
Buses between Kochi and Munnar fill up fast on weekends; reserve KSRTC Swift seats online 2-3 days ahead.
Fort Kochi is extremely walkable and safe for solo travelers at all hours.
Keep cash handy in Munnar as local auto drivers and small tea shops may have spotty network for UPI.
details.booking_notes: Book flight tickets early to secure prices under INR 8,500 round trip. Pre-book Eravikulam National Park tickets on the official Kerala Forest department website. Hostel beds in Fort Kochi and Munnar should be reserved 2 weeks prior.
